fieldNotes.locating: Roster had no address/coords. Resolved via web research: Niagara Bottling Phoenix is consistently listed at 275 S 67th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85043 (TruckMap, Yahoo Local, Yellowpages, D&B, chamber listings). Geocoded that address to a two-building warehouse/distribution complex on the east side of S 67th Ave just south of Washington St.
fieldNotes.buildingId: MEDIUM confidence on identity. The 275 S 67th Ave address is solidly Niagara's, but source data on building size conflicts: Wikipedia cites a 252,000 sq ft Phoenix plant, while a real-estate listing for 275 S 67th Ave describes a 626,970 sq ft warehouse + 3,030 sq ft office + 32 dock doors. The geocoded site is a two-building complex larger than either figure. Could not read a 'Niagara' sign in Street View (heavy tree screening of both office fronts). Audited the complex as the Niagara Phoenix facility per the confirmed address; flagged.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Both buildings sit behind chain-link/masonry perimeter fencing; the fenced dock yards are accessed via gated driveways off S 67th Ave (NW driveway to the north building's dock yard, SW driveway to the south building). Gates inferred from the fence line; exact hardware not directly imaged due to tree cover.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear guard booth seen at either gated driveway.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated, fenced site with no visible guard shack -> remote check-in inferred. Flagged - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two large warehouses each with long dock runs facing a shared central dock yard, plus docks on the north building's far-north face; total estimated ~90 - band 50+. High estimate, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Central dock yard and north yard hold dozens of dropped trailers in marked rows; band 50+.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large warehouse buildings on the same property -> campus. Whether both are Niagara-occupied is uncertain - flagged.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks face the shared yard from two separate buildings; plausibly separate ship/receive clusters - inferred, flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense west-Phoenix industrial corridor abutting residential subdivisions - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~28 acres from the perimeter box covering both buildings + the shared dock yard + parking; flagged as estimate.
